# World of Warcraft UI Community Bug Tracker

This issue tracker is used by the WoW UI developer community to document bugs for Blizzard with a chance of getting them looked at.

There are no guarantees that issues reported here will be fixed, but Blizzard is looking at the list and will triage issues according to their priorities and schedules.

To improve visibility for the development team issues should additionally be reported in-game through the problem reporter or support tools with a brief summary and a link to a ticket created here copied into the report.
Bug reports submitted here should - where possible - include a minimal reproducible test case either as an attached addon or an in-line code snippet, and steps to reproduce the issue.

We might sometimes close an issue as "stale" when there has been no interest or updates from Blizzard regarding it.

# Burning Crusade Anniversary PvP Overview

Updated 16 Mar 2026 Author: **[Nurseos](https://overgear.com/guides/author/ostroumov/ "Posts by Nurseos")**

**~13 min**

In our TBC Anniversary PvP Overview, you’ll find a clear breakdown of how competitive PvP works in the Burning Crusade Anniversary. From Arena system changes and PvP rewards to elite sets and vendor locations, TBC Anniversary PvP focuses on structured combat, rating-based progression, and skill-driven play.

TBC Anniversary PvP Key Takeaways

* Arena is the core competitive PvP mode in TBC Anniversary.
* Arena Teams are removed; ratings are personal and start at 1500.
* PvP progression is season-based, not tied to PvE phases.
* Battlegrounds are unrated and reward Honor Points only.
* Gladiator titles, Nether Drake mounts, and Elite PvP sets come from Arena performance.
* PvP vendors are spread across Shattrath, PvP zones, and Outland locations.

## TBC Anniversary PvP Changes

[Burning Crusade Anniversary PvP Overview](http://overgear.com/guides/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/pvp-improvements-in-tbc-anniversary-scaled.jpg)

PvP in TBC Anniversary brings a new level of competitiveness to players in comparison to Vanilla. The gameplay now moves from rank grinding to an organized form of PvP. Below are the most important features of the changes that have occurred in The Burning Crusade Anniversary PvP system:

* Arena PvP System — Arenas become the central mode of competition. Players compete in 2v2, 3v3, and 5v5 brackets, depending on their ratings.

...

Secure your [TBC Anniversary PvP Sets](https://overgear.com/games/wow-20th-anniversary/arena-set) faster with structured Arena play and steady progression, so you’re ready for competitive matches from the start

### PvP Improvements in TBC Anniversary

Arena PvP in TBC Anniversary has been given some focused modifications regarding how the competition system functions in the original Burning Crusade. Such alterations aim to minimize difficulties, ensure efficient matchmaking, and enable flexible participation in Arena battles on the Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary. Below are some of the primary Arena-related modifications for the Burning Crusade Anniversary:

* Arena Teams Removed — Traditional Arena Teams are now gone. You are no longer forced into set rosters to gain awards or points.
* Personal Rating System —  Arena ratings are now character- and bracket-type-specific (2v2, 3v3, 5v5) instead of team-specific.

...

One of the most significant additions for World PvP in WoW Classic TBC Anniversary is Halaa, which is a capture point and is located in the area of [Nagrand](https://www.wowhead.com/tbc/zone=3518/nagrand) . By controlling Halaa, players have access to obtaining World PvP rewards in the form of tokens and gold. This area often spawns big battles among players, mainly during peak hours.

In contrast to Arena or Battlegrounds, there are no effects on ranking or season rewards for World PvP in TBC Anniversary. These activities in World PvP in TBC Anniversary require spontaneous PvP encounters, rivalry between factions, along rewards to be valuable. Among players in fresh worlds for Burning Crusade, such as WoW TBC Classic Fresh servers, there are highly active World PvPs in the initial expansion levels due to congestion.

## The Burning Crusade Anniversary PvP Rewards

[Burning Crusade Anniversary PvP Overview](http://overgear.
com/guides/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/tbc-anniversary-pvp-rewards-scaled.jpg)

PvP rewards in TBC Anniversary are designed around clear progression and visible achievement, without the extreme grind seen in earlier systems. The Burning Crusade Anniversary model rewards active participation while still keeping top-end rewards exclusive.

In TBC Classic Anniversary, PvP offers a mix of gear, cosmetics, and titles earned through Honor and Arena participation. Honor Points are used to purchase baseline PvP gear and off-pieces, making Battlegrounds and World PvP an important part of overall progression. This gear provides key stats like Resilience, which is essential for PvP survivability in WoW Classic TBC Anniversary.

Higher-tier PvP rewards are tied to competitive performance. Seasonal titles, mounts, and elite cosmetic items are reserved for players who consistently perform well in rated PvP.
These rewards do not reset permanently, but each season offers its own exclusive versions, keeping long-term PvP goals relevant.

Unlike PvE, PvP rewards in Burning Crusade Anniversary clearly reflect player skill rather than time spent farming. Looking to secure PvP rewards in TBC Anniversary faster? Skip slow rating climbs and unreliable teams. Reach your [PvP Rank](https://overgear.com/games/wow-20th-anniversary/rank-boost) with consistent Arena progress and unlock titles, gear, and rewards without wasting weeks on inefficient queues.

### The Burning Crusade Anniversary Arena Rewards

Arena in TBC Anniversary is not just about rating — it’s the main source of the most prestigious PvP rewards in the Burning Crusade Anniversary. Competitive Arena play offers exclusive mounts and titles that clearly reflect a player’s skill and seasonal performance in ranked matches.

### The Burning Crusade Anniversary Rated Battlegrounds Rewards

The Battlegrounds of TBC Anniversary do not have any rewards or progress on their own. Unlike other expansions, Rated Battlegrounds, ranking ladders, and titles for performance in Rated Battlegrounds are not available in The Burning Crusade Anniversary.

For TBC Classic Anniversary, the Battlegrounds award just Honor Points, allowing players to acquire the beginner PvP equipment, as well as off-pieces. There are no special mounts, titles, or cosmetic rewards awarded through the outcome of the Battlegrounds.

Battlegrounds are a main means of gearing up and practicing. Battlegrounds are an effective means of accumulating Honor, teaching PvP game mechanics, and leveling your character up for Arenas in WoW Classic TBC Anniversary.

## The Burning Crusade Anniversary Elite PvP Sets

Elite PvP Sets in TBC Anniversary are rewards related to high performance in the Burning Crusade Anniversary expansion.
They have the same stats as standard PvP gear and offer unique designs with special colors to identify players with high performance in PvP.

In TBC Classic Anniversary, Elite PvP sets can be earned based on the achievement of certain Arena ratings during a season. These sets cannot be earned via Honor grinding or by participating in Battlegrounds, and cannot be earned after a season is finished either. These sets serve solely as a status symbol because they offer no benefits to the player in terms of progress or gameplay enhancement in the game.

TBC Anniversary Fresh Elite sets can be obtained for all classes. They are also linked with success in the Arena. Even though these sets are not power-boosting items, they are what make experienced players in WoW Classic TBC Anniversary PvP stand out.

### The Burning Crusade Anniversary Season 1 Elite Sets
TBC Anniversary Season 1 Elite Sets introduce the first elite PvP appearances available through Arena rating in the Burning Crusade Anniversary. These sets are visual-only rewards that mark high Arena performance during the opening PvP season and become unobtainable once the season ends.
